name: Ledgerline Changes
description: A payments company's API changelog in a docs-like shell: dated versions grouped under named release families with an overview card, Breaking badges, typed rows, a version compare form and GA / preview channels.
features: Release families (Basil, Acacia) with an overview card for each
Change types renamed to an API changelog's words: Added, Changed, Deprecated, Removed
Breaking badge, version pill and GA / Preview channel on every row
Checklist filter: types, tags, Breaking, plus Compare versions (from / to)
Section eyebrows with glyphs, square bullets, screenshots on a soft panel
Grid hero and a light docs shell, with a dark twin
Zero custom CSS — every detail is a theme setting

attrs.heading: Get API changes by email
attrs.body: One email per release family, and one for every breaking change.

posts.title: Basil: one request for every payment method
posts.markdown:
Basil is the API generation that lets one request create a payment for any method a customer chooses. It changes how payment methods are listed and renames two error codes; everything else is additive.

## Added

- `automatic_payment_methods` on every payment request.
- A `payment_method_options` hash per method.

## Changed

- Payment methods are listed newest first.

## Upgrading

Pin `2026-09-30.basil` in a test environment, run your integration tests, then move your account default.

Placeholder release notes.

posts.title: Refund reasons are required for partial refunds
posts.markdown:
Partial refunds now need a `reason`, so disputes can be answered without a support ticket.

## Changed

- `reason` is required when `amount` is less than the charge.

## Upgrading

Send `reason` on partial refunds before upgrading, or the request answers `400`.

Placeholder release notes.

posts.title: Thin events for webhooks (preview)
posts.markdown:
Thin events carry the object id and a type, and you fetch the rest — smaller payloads and no stale snapshots.

## Added

- `event_payload: thin` on webhook endpoints.
- `GET /v2/events/{id}` returns the full object at delivery time.

Placeholder release notes.

posts.title: Acacia: Connect accounts without a type
posts.markdown:
Acacia replaces account types with explicit responsibilities: who collects fees, who is liable for losses and who the dashboard belongs to.

## Added

- `controller` on accounts.

## Deprecated

- `type` on accounts; it keeps working for this family.

Placeholder release notes.

posts.title: Legacy sources are removed
posts.markdown:
The legacy Sources API stops accepting new sources. Existing sources keep charging until they expire.

## Removed

- `POST /v1/sources` for card and bank sources.

## Upgrading

Create payment methods instead; the migration guide maps each source field.

Placeholder release notes.
